\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to hike, to change, to throw, to repeat, to pull
  \item a workplace, a company, a colleague, a colleague, a job
  \item a salary, an identity card, a visa, a traffic jam, an accident
  \item a prescription, a pain, a cold, a cough, the flu
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To hike? (\textbf{wandern}.) To change? (\textbf{wechseln}.) To throw? (\textbf{werfen}.) To repeat? (\textbf{wiederholen}.) To pull? (\textbf{ziehen}.) A workplace? (\textbf{der Arbeitsplatz}.) A company? (\textbf{die Firma}.) A colleague? (\textbf{die Kollegin}.) A colleague? (\textbf{der Kollege}.) A job? (\textbf{die Stelle}.) A salary? (\textbf{das Gehalt}.) An identity card? (\textbf{der Ausweis}.) A visa? (\textbf{das Visum}.) A traffic jam? (\textbf{der Stau}.) An accident? (\textbf{der Unfall}.) A prescription? (\textbf{das Rezept}.) A pain? (\textbf{der Schmerz}.) A cold? (\textbf{die Erkältung}.) A cough? (\textbf{der Husten}.) The flu? (\textbf{die Grippe}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
